name: mdx-merge-edit
description: A monorepo template built with Bun, Hono, Vite, and React
author: Steve Simkins

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT,SHARED" -c "auto" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:shared"
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:client
